03 / LAYERS FOUR SOVEREIGN LAYERS四个主权层

Each layer owns one job —每层只做一件事 —— and only that job且仅此一件事

No layer trusts another with more than it needs. That is what makes the loop sovereign: apps never hold keys, custodians never go online, governance weight is soulbound and never for sale, and AI never acts outside its charter. 任何一层都不把多余的东西交给别人。这正是主权的来源：应用不碰私钥、保管端永不联网、治理权重灵魂绑定永不出售、AI 不越宪章半步。

04 / JOURNEY ONE MESSAGE, SEVEN STOPS一条消息，七站

“gm” travels the“gm” 环游 whole circuit in seconds整条回路只需几秒

Nothing in this sequence trusts a company. Each stop does one job and hands off — that is the entire security model. 这个过程中的每一步都不信任任何公司。每一站只做一件事然后交接 —— 这就是全部的安全模型。

01
USER · SOVEREIGNYou type “gm” in Engine, 9:41你在 Engine 里输入 “gm”，9:41

Two letters. Sovereign by the time they arrive.两个字母。抵达之时已是主权的。

02
VAULT · TEEYour fingerprint authorizes a signature你的指纹授权一次签名

The private key never wakes outside secure silicon. A challenge-response signature rides back through IPC, fresh within ±120 seconds.私钥从不在安全芯片之外醒来。挑战应答签名经 IPC 返回，±120 秒内新鲜有效。

03
ENGINE · RAMMessage sealed end-to-end消息被端到端封装

ECDH shared key + AES-256-GCM with AAD binding. The app holds it in memory only — no disk, no database, no cloud.ECDH 共享密钥 + 带 AAD 绑定的 AES-256-GCM。应用只把它握在内存 —— 无磁盘、无数据库、无云端。

04
📡 RELAY · STATELESSA blind courier forwards ciphertext失明信使转发密文

Challenge-response registered, sequence numbers monotonic. It routes frames it cannot read, stores nothing, and forgets you instantly.挑战应答注册、序列号单调递增。它转发自己读不懂的帧，不存任何东西，转瞬即忘。

05
SPARK · METERFuel is metered and burned燃料被计量并燃烧

Two letters cost a sliver of $SPARK under the 40KB text budget. Expression is energy — literally accounted.在 40KB 文本预算下，两个字母只耗一丝 $SPARK。表达即能量 —— 字面意义上的记账。

06
AETHER · RESERVEA governed share banks into the reserve治理份额收储入储备

Burned fuel feeds the long-term $SPARK reserve — three chambers, 3/5 multisig, public timelock. Nobody's impulse moves it.燃烧的燃料汇入 $SPARK 长期储备 —— 三院、3/5 多签、公开时间锁。任何人的冲动都动不了它。

07
HAVIX · CHARTERA chartered AI rebalances the pools受照 AI 再平衡燃料池

AI keeps liquidity flowing between reserve and app-side fuel pools — inside hard limits, with receipts, red lines routed to human votes. The loop closes; tomorrow's “gm” is already funded.AI 在储备与应用侧燃料池之间维持流动 —— 硬边界内、有回执、红线移交人类表决。回路闭合，明天的 “gm” 已被供能。

06 / WEB3 → WEB4

Web3 gave you keys.Web3 给了你钥匙。 Web4 gives keys a constitution.Web4 给钥匙立了宪。

Owning your keys is not enough if the economy around you is still run by unaccountable intermediaries — human or machine. The loop closes that gap: value flows are public, reserves are SBT-governed, and AI autonomy is bounded by a charter anyone can audit. 如果周围的经济仍由不受问责的中间人（无论人还是机器）掌管，光拥有钥匙并不够。回路补上了这一环：价值流动公开、储备由 SBT 治理、AI 自治被任何人可审计的宪章约束。
